definition_zh: 使丧失（亲人）；夺走；使痛失
definition_en: to deprive someone suddenly of a loved one, or to take away something valued
core_image: 一只手从怀里夺走最珍视的人，怀中只剩空荡
scene: 矿难的消息传来，她怀里只剩丈夫的外套。The mine collapse bereaved her of her husband.
sceneCN: 这里 bereaved 是「使痛失」（第 1 个义项：突然夺走亲人）；句意是矿难夺走了她的丈夫，令她痛失所爱。

pos.zh: 使痛失；使丧失（亲人）；夺走

derivatives.zh: 由动词加名词后缀构成，义为「丧亲之痛；丧失」
过去分词转形容词，义为「丧失的；被剥夺的」

senses.title: To deprive of a loved one
senses.definition: to leave someone suddenly without a relative or friend, especially by death
senses.definitionCN: 尤其因死亡而突然夺走某人的亲人或挚友
senses.example: The mine collapse bereaved her of her husband.
senses.why: Re- means away and the root means to snatch, so it is a violent taking.
senses.whyCN: re- 表「夺离」，词根表「抢夺」，合起来是粗暴的夺走。

senses.title: To strip away something valued
senses.definition: to take away a power, hope, or comfort that someone relied on
senses.definitionCN: 夺走某人赖以依靠的力量、希望或慰藉
senses.example: The long war bereaved the town of its young men and its spirit.
senses.exampleCN: 漫长的战争夺走了小镇的年轻人，也夺走了它的元气。
senses.why: The violent snatching widens from persons to what persons give.
senses.whyCN: 「粗暴夺走」的对象从人扩展到人所带来的东西。

intro.en: Bereave is re- plus an Old English verb meaning to snatch away.
intro.cn: bereave 由 re- 加古英语动词「抢夺」构成。

items.en: the root reup- or reub- meant to snatch, to plunder.
items.cn: 词根 reup- 或 reub- 意为「抢夺、掠夺」（重构形式）。

items.en: bereafian meant to plunder, to deprive by force.
items.cn: 古英语 bereafian 意为「掠夺、强行剥夺」。

items.en: bereven covered robbing goods and losing persons.
items.cn: 中古英语 bereven 既指抢夺财物，也指痛失亲人。

items.en: the human-loss sense became the leading use.
items.cn: 十七世纪「丧失亲人」成为主要用法。

items.en: today the passive participle bereft also works as an adjective.
items.cn: 如今过去分词 bereft 还常用作形容词。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the re- root family or spelling; the near-meaning group gathers words for loss and deprivation.
note.cn: 形近组共享 re- 词族或拼写；近义组汇集丧失、剥夺类词。

entries.definitionCN: 丧失的——bereave 的过去分词形容词

entries.definition: the loss of a loved one
entries.definitionCN: 丧亲之痛——bereave 的名词形式
相信——拼写相近，词源不同
剥夺；强调夺走必需之物

entries.definition: to make a child lose its parents
entries.definitionCN: 使成孤儿——bereave 的具体化

entries.definition: to make someone lose a spouse
entries.definitionCN: 使丧偶——同属亲人丧失义场

normalIntro.en: Bereave means to snatch a loved one away.
normalIntro.cn: bereave 意为夺走所爱的人。

normal.cn: bereaved families 指痛失亲人的家庭。

normal.en: Be bereaved of hope means lose hope.
normal.cn: be bereaved of hope 指失去希望。

abstract.en: See empty arms holding only a coat.
abstract.cn: 看怀里只剩外套的空荡双臂。

abstract.en: Feel a chair forever empty at dinner.
abstract.cn: 感受餐桌上永远空着的椅子。

abstract.en: Picture a thief taking not gold but a face.
abstract.cn: 想象窃贼偷走的不是金子而是一张脸。

examples.en: The mine collapse bereaved her of her husband.
The long war bereaved the town of its young men and its spirit.
examples.cn: 漫长的战争夺走了小镇的年轻人，也夺走了它的元气。

examples.en: The flood left many bereaved families along the river.
examples.cn: 洪水在河沿岸留下许多痛失亲人的家庭。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「必·离夫」——灾祸一来，必让妻离子散、痛失丈夫。

root: 前缀 re-（表「夺离」，与 rob、rip 同出原始印欧语词根 reup- 或 reub-「抢夺」，属重构形式）加古英语 -reafian「掠夺」，复合为 bereafian「强行剥夺」；中古英语 bereven 兼指夺财与失亲，十七世纪起以「使痛失亲人」为主。

sensesIntro.en: One verb of violent taking moves from loved ones to the hopes and spirit they carried.
sensesIntro.cn: 一个动词的暴力夺走，从所爱之人蔓延到他们所承载的希望与元气。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: empty arms holding only a coat.
core.cn: 核心意象：怀里只剩外套的空荡双臂。

intro.en: Bereave joins the away root re- to the snatching root reaf-.
intro.cn: bereave 把「夺离」词根 re- 与「抢夺」词根 reaf- 相连。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin base; the word is Germanic throughout.
latinIntro.cn: 这里没有拉丁词基，全词为日耳曼语源。
